name: qBittorrent
author: Viboplr
description: Control a qBittorrent WebUI from Viboplr: add magnet links, choose what downloads, watch progress, and play or import finished files. Requires qBittorrent 5.2.3+ and an API key.

permissionReasons.network:*: Talk to the qBittorrent Web UI at the address you set, and search torrent sites directly with the built-in indexers
permissionReasons.system:open: Open downloaded files and folders, the qBittorrent Web UI and download page, and a result's torrent page
permissionReasons.files:read: Read title, artist and album from finished files instead of guessing from the file name
permissionReasons.library:read: See your local collections, to tell which one a finished torrent landed in
permissionReasons.library:write: Rescan the collection a finished torrent landed in, so its files reach your library
permissionReasons.playback:read: Read how long the queue is, to add torrent files at its end
permissionReasons.playback:control: Play or queue files straight out of your torrents

viewHeader.subtitle: Search, download and play torrents through your qBittorrent

assistant.instructions: Fetch music over BitTorrent through the user's qBittorrent server. Flow: status (connected? where do downloads land?) → search_torrents (qBittorrent's installed search plugins; slow, up to ~40s) → add_torrent with a result's source + engine as downloader. Downloads save into the configured destination collection and reach the library when files finish; watch progress with list_torrents. add_torrent is a real download the user's server performs — only add what the user actually asked for.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Connection state, torrent count, and which collection finished downloads land in

tools.name: list_torrents
tools.description: The torrents qBittorrent is managing: name, state, progress (0-1), size

tools.name: search_torrents
tools.description: Search via qBittorrent's installed search plugins — slow (runs up to ~40s). Returns name/size/seeders/engine/source; feed a result's source (+ engine as downloader) to add_torrent

tools.name: add_torrent
tools.description: Add a magnet link or .torrent URL to qBittorrent (saves into the destination collection, sequential download). A real download — add only what the user asked for

downloader.description: The search plugin that produced the result (its engine field) — needed when source is a description page
